metadata_review.title: 1990 context is commercial introduction/recalled show, not a claim every preserved prototype was made in1990.
metadata_review.description: Explicitly distinguishes catalogue prototype, patent proposals, later named recollection, Alben personal account and 1997 publication.
metadata_review.tags_thumbnail: No extra priority, clinical effect, invented price or unsupported specification. Brand text is overlay metadata, not a generated-image logo request.

key_boundaries.MoMA_17_8_cm: Only entire single object401.1994, not handle length or all OXO products.
key_boundaries.bubble_sequence: 2001 article publication does not order the bubble scheme relative to museum foam/wood. No liquid/gas recipe.
key_boundaries.patent_vs_BOM: P0 is a design disclosure; X16 is another catalogue prototype, not the first production BOM.
key_boundaries.retail_carrots: S4 and PBS deepen one Lechters/carrot demonstration; Alben carrot is a separate clearly attributed household account.
key_boundaries.Alben: Summer1997 is publication only; named Jim and Paula are husband’s parents, not diagnosed study patients; comments are reported, not measured efficacy.
key_boundaries.manufacturing: C3 double-shot steel-mould account belongs to adjacent ski-pole prototype. OXO only uses its own injection-moulded description and general granular-material explanation.
key_boundaries.unobtained_originals: No original letters,1990 actual first-sale price/manufacturing contract or listened audio claimed.
